status: reverse-engineering handoff; not a complete original DSP specification

hardware_controls.label: Scan / Follow traversal
hardware_controls.recovered: Scan approximately 480000/4095 samples per calibrated 12-bit unit; Follow uses a separate speed helper.
hardware_controls.open: Omega endpoint and capture-head boundary branches unresolved.

hardware_controls.label: Grain duration / wavetable entry
hardware_controls.recovered: u² * 100000 units, then *1.44 samples clamped 128..144000 in nominal-48k domain.
hardware_controls.open: Mode-dependent entry thresholds and exact physical minimum require validation.

hardware_controls.label: Pitch CV
hardware_controls.recovered: 1 V/oct is the documented musical contract; raw hardware and WT paths require calibration.
hardware_controls.open: Do not use raw ADC scaling as a Rack volts formula.

hardware_controls.label: Pitch knob
hardware_controls.recovered: Named pitch functions and exact PITCH_VALUES table recovered.
hardware_controls.open: Full normal-mode center detent, quantisation, and MIDI merge not completely reconstructed.

hardware_controls.label: Layer / Omega
hardware_controls.recovered: Six layers plus Omega; play and record layer may be separate.
hardware_controls.open: Notes distinguish layer CV channel 4; switching/hysteresis and coupling need complete truth table.

hardware_controls.label: Dry / Wet
hardware_controls.recovered: Steady-state equal-power cosine/sine curve; raw control is inverted in the main patch.
hardware_controls.open: Pd table approximation and smoothing not reproduced by ideal C++ sin/cos.

hardware_controls.label: Hold
hardware_controls.recovered: Onset hold state; recorder converts shared milliseconds with factor 48.
hardware_controls.open: Also affects Follow loop-length policy when configured; full panel law unresolved.

hardware_controls.label: Spray
hardware_controls.recovered: u² * 100000 units, then *4.8 samples; Scan and Follow use different placement branches.
hardware_controls.open: Not a proven uniform bipolar offset; MIDI slot 212 participates upstream.

hardware_controls.label: Grain direction probability
hardware_controls.recovered: Per-grain direction and _dirPercent are present; reverse branch distinct.
hardware_controls.open: Complete probability transfer and draw order unresolved.

hardware_controls.label: Dub / recording blend
hardware_controls.recovered: Recorder has handover state and coefficient slew near 0.0078/sample.
hardware_controls.open: Complete record equation and all capture fades unresolved.

hardware_controls.label: Continuous grain production
hardware_controls.recovered: Separate continuous and struck engines; timing and amplitude randomization are independent options.
hardware_controls.open: Exact density law and duration coupling are high-priority open work.

hardware_controls.label: Configurable modulation
hardware_controls.recovered: Enum selects none/pan/hold/reverb/delay; dedicated defaults also exist.
hardware_controls.open: Do not make effects mutually exclusive in the 2.1-style feature set.

hardware_controls.label: Grain window / texture
hardware_controls.recovered: 101 x 515 reconstructed bank from exact templates.
hardware_controls.open: Complete control-to-row and reverse phase stepping not proven.

hardware_controls.label: Pitch deviation
hardware_controls.recovered: Ordered quantisation sequences and setDeviation routine recovered.
hardware_controls.open: Probability selection, continuous vs quantised behavior, and timing still incomplete.

hardware_controls.label: Capture button/CV
hardware_controls.recovered: CV modes latch/momentary/retrigger; separate button policy.
hardware_controls.open: Simultaneous events, accumulative behavior, and record destination locking need tests.

hardware_controls.label: Strike button/CV
hardware_controls.recovered: Independent grain event source with configurable CV delay.
hardware_controls.open: Pitch/control latch timing and scheduler order remain explicit fidelity work.

hardware_controls.label: Shift / gesture layer
hardware_controls.recovered: Multiple mode/gesture handlers and staged parameter behavior.
hardware_controls.open: Full hold/double-press timing and precedence not recovered.

hardware_controls.label: Onset sensitivity / alternate input level
hardware_controls.recovered: Normal onset path is bonk~ after four hip~300 stages.
hardware_controls.open: Analog control and stereo-mode level behavior not fully reconstructed.

hardware_controls.label: Input level
hardware_controls.recovered: Separate input conditioning and analog preamp/limiter target.
hardware_controls.open: No authentic analog transfer measurement supplied.

hardware_controls.label: Output level
hardware_controls.recovered: Main output/phase/mute path separate from rational clipping.
hardware_controls.open: Absolute hardware dB/V calibration not established.
